I have a severe case of mixed-type Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (I have Classical, Hypermobile and Vascular types).

It's a connective tissue disorder, meaning I can't properly make collagen (the glue that holds every cell together) or cartilage (protects your joints, makes up most of your nose & ears as well as holding your ribcage together).

I also have Gastroparesis (a paralysed digestive system, hence the tube), Dysautonomia (dysfunction of the autonomic system which controls all the subconscious functions like heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, temperature control etc etc) and just as a final kick in the teeth I'm deaf!
